Rocky Mountain Area(PL 3)   
Fire Activity and Teams Assigned Totals 
New fires: 11 
New large incidents: 2 
Uncontained large fires: 11 
CIMTs Committed: 1 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 2). CIMT is also managing the 
Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Moderate fire 
behavior with flanking, backing and creeping. Numerous structures threatened. Evacuations, area, road and 
trail closures in effect. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. Precipitation occurred over the fire 
area yesterday. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Moderate fire behavior with flanking, backing and creeping. Energy infrastructure threatened. 
Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
backing, creeping and single tree torching. Communication infrastructure threatened. Area closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Communication infrastructure threatened. 
 
Post, Las Animas County. Seven miles southeast of Trinidad, CO. Grass and brush. Active fire behavior. 
 
* Sheep Pen, Las Animas County. Twelve miles southeast of Kim, CO. Grass and brush. Active fire behavior 
with creeping and isolated torching. 
 
Rancher, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Two miles east of Evergreen, SD. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. 
 
* Redwood, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Two miles northeast of Manderson, SD. Heavy slash, light slash and 
grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping. 
 
Weiser Knoll, Wind River/Bighorn Basin District, BLM. Thirteen miles southeast of Lander, WY. Grass, brush 
and timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Residences threatened. Area closures in effect. Last report 
unless significant activity occurs. 
 
XU Hill, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Twelve miles north of White River Ranger Station, SD. Grass and brush. 
Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. Last report unless 
significant activity occurs.
